title: Lexus USA pressroom: 2026 RZ goes on sale, expanded charging network options for all Lexus BEV owners
notes: 25,000+ NACS plugs via Tesla Supercharger Network for 2026 RZ owners; MY2023-25 need a CCS to SAE J3400 adapter (complimentary via dealer); 2026 BEVs ship with J1772 and CCS adapters.
